UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION

FORM 8-K

FICTIONAL TEST CORP. (CIK 0009999991)

Item 1.05 Material Cybersecurity Incidents.

On April 25, 2026, Fictional Test Corp. ("the Company") detected unauthorized activity on portions of its corporate network. The Company promptly initiated its incident response plan, engaged external forensic investigators, and notified federal law enforcement.

The threat actor deployed ransomware that encrypted certain systems and exfiltrated a limited subset of customer data, including personal information of certain customers. The Company experienced operational disruption at one regional facility while it brought systems back online from clean backups.

While the investigation is ongoing, the Company believes the incident is reasonably likely to have a material impact on its results of operations for the current fiscal quarter.
